{"sql": "WITH q AS (

              WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-04-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01' THEN 'Q2' END AS quarter,
         SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value) AS gmv
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled','unavailable')
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT

  MAX(CASE WHEN quarter='Q2' THEN gmv END) AS q2_gmv,
  ROUND((MAX(CASE WHEN quarter='Q2' THEN gmv END) - MAX(CASE WHEN quarter='Q1' THEN gmv END))
        / MAX(CASE WHEN quarter='Q1' THEN gmv END) * 100, 2) AS change_pct
FROM q;"}

function.arguments:
{"sql": "WITH q AS (
  SELECT p.product_category_name AS cat,
         CASE WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-04-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01' THEN 'Q2'
              WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-04-01' THEN 'Q1' END AS qtr,
         SUM(oi.price) AS gmv
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled','unavailable')
    AND p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01'
  GROUP BY 1,2
), piv AS (
  SELECT cat,
         SUM(CASE WHEN qtr='Q1' THEN gmv END) AS q1_gmv,
         SUM(CASE WHEN qtr='Q2' THEN gmv END) AS q2_gmv
  FROM q GROUP BY cat
), both AS (
  SELECT cat, q1_gmv, q2_gmv, q2_gmv - q1_gmv AS diff
  FROM piv WHERE q1_gmv IS NOT NULL AND q2_gmv IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM both WHERE diff < 0) AS declining_categories,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM both) AS compared_categories,
  (SELECT cat FROM both ORDER BY diff ASC LIMIT 1) AS largest_drop_category,
  (SELECT diff FROM both ORDER BY diff ASC LIMIT 1) AS largest_drop_amount,
  (SELECT q1_gmv FROM both ORDER BY diff ASC LIMIT 1) AS largest_drop_q1_gmv,
  (SELECT q2_gmv FROM both ORDER BY diff ASC LIMIT 1) AS largest_drop_q2_gmv;"}

{"sql": "WITH q2 AS (
  SELECT o.order_id, o.customer_id, o.order_status, c.customer_unique_id, c.customer_state
  FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
  WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-04-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01'
  AND c.customer_state IN ('SP','RJ')
),
buyers AS (
  SELECT customer_state, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) AS buyers
  FROM q2 GROUP BY customer_state
),
gmv AS (
  SELECT q.customer_state, SUM(oi.price) AS gmv, COUNT(DISTINCT q.order_id) AS gmv_orders
  FROM q2 q JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = q.order_id
  WHERE q.order_status NOT IN ('canceled','unavailable')
  GROUP BY q.customer_state
)
SELECT b.customer_state, b.buyers, g.gmv, g.gmv_orders,
       ROUND(g.gmv / g.gmv_orders, 2) AS gmv_per_order
FROM buyers b JOIN gmv g USING (customer_state)
ORDER BY b.customer_state;"}

function.arguments:
{"sql": "WITH q2 AS (
  SELECT o.order_id, o.order_status, c.customer_unique_id, c.customer_state
  FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
  WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-04-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01'
  AND c.customer_state IN ('SP','RJ')
),
buyers AS (SELECT customer_state, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) AS buyers FROM q2 GROUP BY customer_state),
gmv AS (
  SELECT q.customer_state, SUM(oi.price) AS gmv, COUNT(DISTINCT q.order_id) AS gmv_orders
  FROM q2 q JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = q.order_id
  WHERE q.order_status NOT IN ('canceled','unavailable')
  GROUP BY q.customer_state
),
agg AS (
  SELECT b.customer_state, b.buyers, g.gmv, g.gmv_orders, ROUND(g.gmv/g.gmv_orders,2) AS gmv_per_order
  FROM buyers b JOIN gmv g USING (customer_state)
)
SELECT
  MAX(buyers) FILTER (WHERE customer_state='SP') AS sp_buyers,
  MAX(buyers) FILTER (WHERE customer_state='RJ') AS rj_buyers,
  MAX(gmv) FILTER (WHERE customer_state='SP') AS sp_gmv,
  MAX(gmv) FILTER (WHERE customer_state='RJ') AS rj_gmv,
  MAX(gmv_per_order) FILTER (WHERE customer_state='SP') AS sp_gmv_per_order,
  MAX(gmv_per_order) FILTER (WHERE customer_state='RJ') AS rj_gmv_per_order,
  ROUND(MAX(buyers) FILTER (WHERE customer_state='SP')::numeric / NULLIF(MAX(buyers) FILTER (WHERE customer_state='RJ'),0), 2) AS buyers_ratio_sp_rj,
  ROUND(MAX(gmv) FILTER (WHERE customer_state='SP') / NULLIF(MAX(gmv) FILTER (WHERE customer_state='RJ'),0), 2) AS gmv_ratio_sp_rj,
  ROUND(MAX(gmv_per_order) FILTER (WHERE customer_state='RJ') - MAX(gmv_per_order) FILTER (WHERE customer_state='SP'), 2) AS aov_gap_rj_minus_sp
FROM agg;"}

{"sql": "WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-04-01' THEN 'Q1'
         WHEN order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-04-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01' THEN 'Q2' END AS quarter,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (order_delivered_customer_date - order_purchase_timestamp))/86400.0 AS days
  FROM orders
  WHERE order_status = 'delivered'
    AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
    AND order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01'
    AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01'
)
SELECT
  ROUND(AVG(days) FILTER (WHERE quarter='Q1'), 4) AS q1_days,
  ROUND(AVG(days) FILTER (WHERE quarter='Q2'), 4) AS q2_days,
  ROUND((AVG(days) FILTER (WHERE quarter='Q2') - AVG(days) FILTER (WHERE quarter='Q1')), 4) AS change_days,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE quarter='Q1') AS q1_orders,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE quarter='Q2') AS q2_orders
FROM base;"}

{"sql": "WITH q2_orders AS (
  SELECT order_id FROM orders
  WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-04-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01'

SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM q2_orders) AS orders,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) FROM q2_orders o JOIN order_reviews r ON r.order_id = o.order_id) AS reviewed_orders,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM q2_orders o JOIN order_reviews r ON r.order_id = o.order_id) AS review_rows,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.review_id) FROM q2_orders o JOIN order_reviews r ON r.order_id = o.order_id) AS distinct_review_ids,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM q2_orders o JOIN order_reviews r ON r.order_id = o.order_id) - (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) FROM q2_orders o JOIN order_reviews r ON r.order_id = o.order_id) AS row_minus_order_diff,
  ROUND(100.0 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM q2_orders o JOIN order_reviews r ON r.order_id = o.order_id) / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) FROM q2_orders o JOIN order_reviews r ON r.order_id = o.order_id),0), 2) AS rows_pct_of_reviewed_orders,
  ROUND(100.0 * (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) FROM q2_orders o JOIN order_reviews r ON r.order_id = o.order_id) / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM q2_orders),0), 2) AS reviewed_order_rate_pct
"}

SELECT

  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE n_review_ids > 1) AS orders_with_multiple_review_ids,

2018 年 Q2（下单时间 2018-04-01 至 2018-06-30）SP 与 RJ 对比：

1) 真实下单客户数（按 customer_unique_id 去重，含所有订单状态）：SP 8,913 人，RJ 2,345 人，SP 是 RJ 的 3.80 倍。
2) GMV（仅商品价格 price 合计，排除 canceled 与 unavailable 订单）：SP 1,173,308.82，RJ 352,617.27，SP 是 RJ 的 3.33 倍。

规模与客单结构解读：
- 规模上 SP 全面领先，但客户数倍数（3.80）高于 GMV 倍数（3.33），说明 RJ 的单客/单笔产出更高，规模差距主要来自客户基数而非消费能力。
- 客单结构上，RJ 的每单 GMV 为 148.28，SP 为 130.60，RJ 高出 17.68（约 13.5%）。即 RJ 以约 1/4 的客户体量贡献了约 30% 的 SP 级 GMV，客单价更“重”。
- 口径说明：客户数按客户唯一标识去重且不筛状态；GMV 仅计商品金额（未含运费 freight_value），若需含运费口径需另行计算。

response.answer: 2018 年 Q1（按购买日期 1/1–3/31）已送达且有实际送达时间的订单共 20,627 单，平均交付天数 15.7449 天；Q2（4/1–6/30）共 19,643 单，平均 10.7703 天。两期相差 -4.9746 天，即 Q2 平均交付时长比 Q1 缩短约 4.97 天（降幅约 31.6%，由 SQL 计算）。口径说明：交付天数 = order_delivered_customer_date − order_purchase_timestamp，按小数天（秒/86400）计算，仅取 order_status='delivered' 且实际送达时间非空的订单，分期依据购买时间戳。时效变化讨论：Q2 交付时效明显改善，平均缩短近 5 天，说明该期间履约/物流效率有实质提升；但需注意这是整体均值，未区分地区、品类与卖家结构变化，也未剔除极端长尾订单的影响，因此不宜直接归因为单一运营改进。

2018 年 Q2（按 order_purchase_timestamp 落在 2018-04-01 00:00:00 至 2018-07-01 00:00:00 之前，且 order_status = 'delivered'）的已送达订单共 19,646 笔，其中 3 笔缺少 order_delivered_customer_date（实际交付时间戳为空），无法判断是否迟到，因此被排除在分母之外。

- late_orders（实际交付晚于预计交付的订单数）：1,000
- measured_orders（实际交付时间完整、可度量的订单数，即分母）：19,643
- late_pct（迟到率）：5.0909%

口径说明：
1. 迟到判定使用原始时间戳直接比较 order_delivered_customer_date > order_estimated_delivery_date，不截断为日期；因此"同一天但晚于预计时刻"的订单也会被计为迟到。
2. 分母为"实际交付时间完整"的已送达订单数（19,643），而非全部已送达订单数（19,646）；缺失交付时间戳的 3 笔订单既不能算迟到也不能算准时，故剔除。若以全部已送达订单为分母，比率会略低，但该口径不严谨。
3. 时间归属按下单时间（order_purchase_timestamp）划分季度，而非交付时间。

response.answer:
2018 年 Q2（下单时间 2018-04-01 至 2018-06-30，含首尾不含 7 月）共 19,979 笔订单，其中 19,947 笔有商品明细、19,979 笔有支付记录。

三项口径（BRL）：
- 商品金额 item_total = 2,858,289.74
- 运费 freight_total = 473,867.23
- 支付金额 payment_total = 3,338,648.13
- 商品+运费 = 3,332,156.97

对比：
- 支付金额 − 商品金额 = 480,358.39（支付金额比商品金额高 16.81%）
- 支付金额 −（商品+运费）= 6,491.16
- 运费占商品金额 16.58%

为什么不应把支付金额直接当作商品 GMV：
1. 支付金额天然包含运费。运费合计 473,867.23，占商品金额 16.58%，是支付金额与商品金额差额 480,358.39 的绝大部分；把支付金额当 GMV 会把物流收入算进商品销售。
2. 支付金额与「商品+运费」也并非完全相等：有 75 笔订单的支付合计不等于商品+运费（多付合计 229.96、少付合计 0.38），差额净额 6,491.16。原因包括分期/多次支付（525 笔订单有多条支付记录）、支付金额与订单明细口径差异、以及 32 笔订单有商品明细但无支付记录（其商品金额未计入支付侧）。
3. 因此支付金额是「资金流」口径，商品金额是「商品销售」口径，两者覆盖的订单集合与构成不同，混用会导致 GMV 虚高约 16.8%，且无法与商品/品类/卖家维度对齐。

建议：商品 GMV 用 order_items.price 汇总；GMV+运费用 price+freight_value；支付金额仅用于现金流/支付方式分析。

2017 年（订单购买时间 2017-01-01 00:00:00 至 2017-12-31 23:59:59，含全部订单状态）有过下单的真实客户数为 43,713 人；其中年内下单 ≥2 次的客户为 1,256 人；年内复购率 = 1,256 / 43,713 = 2.87%。

口径说明：
- 客户身份按 customers.customer_unique_id 去重（customer_id 为每笔订单的客户记录标识，同一真实客户可能对应多个 customer_id）。
- 观察窗口为自然年 2017 年，仅统计购买时间落在该窗口内的订单；窗口外（2016 及 2018 年）的订单不计入，因此该复购率是"年内复购率"，会低估跨年复购行为。
- 订单状态未做过滤（canceled、unavailable 等全部保留），订单数按 DISTINCT order_id 计。

claims.text: 2017 年有过下单的真实客户数（按 customer_unique_id 去重，全部订单状态）为 43,713 人
2017 年内至少下单两次的客户数为 1,256 人

response.answer:
2018 年 Q2（按 order_purchase_timestamp 落在 2018-04-01 至 2018-06-30 之间，左闭右开）：
- 订单总数 orders = 19,979
- 已评价订单数 reviewed_orders（有评价记录的 distinct order_id）= 19,863
- 评价记录数 review_rows（订单×评价行数）= 19,889

用评价记录数当已评价订单数会怎样：
1) 会高估 26 个订单（19,889 − 19,863 = 26），即高估 100.13% − 100% = 0.13 个百分点；把 19,889 当作已评价订单数，会把评价覆盖率从 99.42% 虚抬到约 99.55%（19,889/19,979）。
2) 原因是 26 个订单各有 2 条评价记录（每单最多 2 行，多出的行数合计 26），属于一对多关系；直接 COUNT(*) 会把订单重复计数。
3) 另外，评价记录中 distinct review_id 只有 19,852，比 19,889 行少 37，说明存在同一 review_id 关联到多个订单的情况，因此 review_id 也不能当作订单唯一键。
结论：统计"已评价订单数"必须用 COUNT(DISTINCT order_id)；评价记录数只适合衡量评价条数/评价量，不能替代订单口径，否则会重复计数并轻微高估覆盖率。

claims.text: 2018 Q2 订单总数、已评价订单数、评价记录数分别为 19,979 / 19,863 / 19,889
评价记录数比已评价订单数多 26 行，源于 26 个订单各有 2 条评价记录（每单最多 2 行，多出合计 26 行）
